name: B10-0357/2025 (S&D) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It supports Moldova's independence and its path to joining the EU. It asks the EU to give Moldova more money, expertise and sanctions to fight Russian interference, disinformation and vote-buying before Moldova's parliamentary elections on 28 September 2025. It also asks Moldova to keep reforming its courts and fighting corruption.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only asks for more EU support and sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova's government, media and voters before the 28 September 2025 election.
- **What happens next:** The requests go to the EU Commission, Council and Moldova's government.
